_about: AI-assisted: researched and assembled with ChatGPT (OpenAI). See docs/AI_USAGE.md. Snapshot compiled 2026-09-26 from Fiscalía General de la Nación’s September 2014 official report and dated Colombian reporting. These are two distinct, descriptively named 2014 case networks. The first contains eleven historically convicted defendants; the second contains five defendants charged and placed under pretrial detention in 2014, with no later disposition verified. Statuses are historical source snapshots, not claims of present incarceration or pending proceedings. Country associations mean Colombia-based historical operation; destination or arrest-only countries are omitted. No exact routes, private locations, inferred co-defendant links, or unlicensed photos.
